add_friend_auto_accepted: You're now friends — they had already sent you a request.
add_friend_hint: Search by username (at least 2 characters). Results come from this Pulse instance.
add_server_dialog_already_in_list: This server is already in your list.
add_server_dialog_error_bad_url: Not a valid URL — e.g. chat.company.com or https://chat.company.com.
add_server_dialog_error_cert_expired: The server's certificate has expired. The operator needs to renew it.
add_server_dialog_error_cert_name: The server's certificate is for a different name. Does this address really point at this server?
add_server_dialog_error_cert_untrusted: The server has no publicly valid certificate. Usually it cannot obtain one because port 80 is closed, or the DNS record was still missing when it tried.
add_server_dialog_error_cors: Server is blocking cross-origin connections. The admin needs to configure CORS.
add_server_dialog_error_dns_unknown: The name does not resolve. Is the DNS record for this address in place yet?
add_server_dialog_error_no_gateway: Something answers at this address, but it is not a Pulse server. Does the proxy rule really point at Pulse?
add_server_dialog_error_no_ws_upgrade: The server answers, but the proxy in front of it does not pass WebSocket connections through. Chat stays empty without them. The operator needs to enable upgrade forwarding in the reverse proxy.
add_server_dialog_error_port_closed: The address exists, but nothing answers on port 443. Is the server running, and is the port open in the firewall?
add_server_dialog_error_server_without_c: The server is reachable, but has not finished starting up internally yet. Try again in a moment; if it persists, contact the server's operator.
add_server_dialog_error_timeout: The server did not answer in time. Try again in a moment.
add_server_dialog_error_too_old: Server update likely in progress — try again in a few minutes.
add_server_dialog_error_unreachable: Server unreachable — check the URL or try a VPN?
add_server_dialog_error_unreadable: Could not read the server response.
add_server_flow_cert_invalid: Server rejected the identity cert (revoked / wrong cloud?).
add_server_flow_instance_banned: You have been banned from this server.
add_server_flow_join_locked: This server is currently locked and not accepting anyone.
add_server_flow_no_cert: No identity cert on this device — please log in first.
add_server_flow_rate_limited: Too many sign-in attempts — please wait a moment and try again.
add_server_flow_signature_invalid: Invalid signature — keypair does not match the cert.
